scoring.location_preferences:

  1. <primary country> — PRIMARY target. Score fit normally.
  2. <secondary countries, if any> — SECONDARY. Apply a point penalty (e.g. -15) to reflect lower priority.
  3. <conditional countries> — conditional rules (e.g. minimum salary threshold).
  4. Any other country — DISQUALIFIED.
scoring.hard_disqualifiers:
HARD DISQUALIFIERS — if ANY apply, set "disqualified": true and score ≤ 20:
  • <add your own disqualifiers>
  • e.g. PhD required, 5+ years required, senior/staff/principal level, out-of-preference country, etc.
scoring.country_codes: Comma-separated country codes used in the JSON output field 'country' — e.g. 'US, UK, OTHER'.
